sources.label: Official JACK & JONES UK size guide (tops chest; sweat pants & shorts letter-size waist), cm

audit: Old source was a stockist (McElhinneys); now read on jackjones.com/en-gb. Chest (TOPS chart) was already right (92-120). Waist comes from the same page's BOTTOMS table, whose 'Sweat pants & shorts' row keys the pant-waist column by the same letter sizes (XS = W28 = 76 cm ... XXL = W38 = 101 cm); old waists were 1-3 cm off (XS 78 -> 76, L 90 -> 91, XL 97 -> 96, XXL 104 -> 101). UK/EU/US removed: JACK & JONES only gives UK/EU equivalents for tailoring (EU 44-60), not for letter-size tops.
